description: This Java source file defines a custom mailbox type for Akka actors, specifically handling PolicyModifyCommand messages with capacity-based control. It implements a mailbox that limits the number of PolicyModifyCommand messages enqueued based on a configured capacity, and rejects additional modify requests when the limit is exceeded, sending an error response.
